summary: Historical TradingView experiences remain excluded from model training, but aggregate experience projections drop UNVERIFIED_TIMEZONE and can label the same records MEASURED, weakening downstream temporal-provenance visibility.
surface: Historical trade experience aggregation and Learning UI projection

evidence.finding: Historical CSV/XLSX import writes time_quality=UNVERIFIED_TIMEZONE and diverts requested backfill slots to immutable trade_experience records; experience_summary and historical_artifact_configuration_summary then aggregate timestamps/P&L and emit status=MEASURED by count without carrying or checking time_quality.

The UI displays aggregate historical P&L, session, state, and MEASURED chips but does not display temporal quality; nearby text correctly says outcome memory is not forecast accuracy and historical evidence is never promoted to runtime configuration.

Regression coverage verifies import report time_quality=UNVERIFIED_TIMEZONE and verifies the same import becomes aggregate experience; it also proves a requested logit backfill returns slot=trade_experience, providing a negative control against direct model training.
Adversarial closure tests defend structural admission but do not establish source-timezone qualification.

daedalus.finding: The inspected historical CSV/XLSX path is isolated as descriptive trade_experience memory; requested model slots do not train on these records and historical evidence cannot enter RUNTIME_CLOSURE_CONFIG.

aegis.finding: Temporal uncertainty is stored on individual experiences and import reports but omitted from aggregate API/UI cards, which can show MEASURED plus clock-derived first/last timestamps without an explicit UNVERIFIED_TIMEZONE warning.

remediation: Propagate time_quality and time_interpretation into experience summaries and historical artifact cards.
Replace generic MEASURED for temporally unqualified historical groups with STRUCTURALLY_MEASURED_TIME_UNQUALIFIED or an equivalent explicit two-axis state.
Expose counts by time_quality and reject session/regime/time-of-day feature construction unless the group is timezone-qualified.
Add regression tests proving aggregate and UI projections preserve UNVERIFIED_TIMEZONE.
